# Polymer Doctor

> Polymer Diagnostics & Research Center (PDRC) — a Delhi-based polymer testing, diagnostics and consultancy company serving processors, recyclers, compounders and product manufacturers across India and internationally.

Polymer Doctor diagnoses the root cause of polymer failures and prescribes a workable fix — not just a pass/fail lab report. Founded and led by CEO Harshita.

## Services

- Polymer identification (FTIR spectroscopy, DSC cross-check, density & burn-test triage)
- Rheological testing (Melt Flow Index / MFI, capillary & rotational rheometry)
- Thermal analysis (DSC, TGA, HDT & Vicat softening point)
- Mechanical testing (tensile, flexural, impact, hardness, fatigue)
- Compositional analysis (ash & filler content, contaminant screening, additive ratios)
- Color & optical testing (L*a*b*, haze, gloss)
- Failure analysis (microscopy, fractography, root-cause investigation)
- Physical properties (density, specific gravity, bulk density, granule uniformity)
- Bio-compostable plastic testing (per IS 17088 / ASTM D6400)
- Polymer consultancy and formulation: MFI modification, coupling agents, flame retardants, oxo-biodegradable additives, exothermic foaming agents, elastomer & rubber compounding

## Products

- MFI Reducer — additive that lowers MFI in pipe-grade HDPE for improved impact strength and ESCR, at roughly 1% dosage
- PP MFI Enhancer — additive that raises MFI in recycled PP film and raffia scrap, making it suitable for injection molding (thin-wall containers, large-format parts, rope, chairs/furniture)

## Reference material

- Polymer Guide: identification specs, solubility, specification standards, processing parameters, and verified invention history for 21+ industrial polymers (LDPE, HDPE, PP, PVC, PS, PET, PC, Nylon, ABS, PMMA, PLA, PU, EVA, POM, PTFE, TPU, EPDM, Natural Rubber, NBR, Silicone Rubber, PBAT)
- Testing Capabilities: full list of tests performed, with equipment used and why each test matters
